items.title: 據報道，普丁建議與川普和習近平舉行峰會，以決定烏克蘭的命運。
items.titleEn: Putin reportedly suggests summit with Trump and Xi to decide fate of Ukraine
items.titleZh: 據報道，普丁建議與川普和習近平舉行峰會，以決定烏克蘭的命運。
items.summaryEn: The report comes amid mounting tensions between Ukraine and the United States, its largest military backer.
items.summaryZh: 這份報告發布之際，正值烏克蘭與其最大的軍事支持者美國之間的緊張局勢不斷加劇之時。

items.title: 時刻在線，時刻監聽：新型人工智慧設備正在挑戰法律底線，可能危及用戶安全。
items.titleEn: Always on, always listening: New AI devices are pushing legal limits and could put users in jeopardy
items.titleZh: 時刻在線，時刻監聽：新型人工智慧設備正在挑戰法律底線，可能危及用戶安全。
items.summaryEn: AI always-listening wearables from Apple, Amazon, Meta and other startups are getting creative with privacy rules and fueling concerns about covert recordings.
items.summaryZh: 蘋果、亞馬遜、Meta 和其他新創公司推出的 AI 全天候監聽穿戴式裝置在隱私規則方面越來越有創意，引發了人們對秘密錄音的擔憂。

items.title: 川普以國家利益為由，依據《格雷厄姆法案》豁免了對俄羅斯實施的一系列新的製裁和關稅。
items.titleEn: Trump waives broad new Russia sanctions and tariffs under Graham Act, citing national interest
items.titleZh: 川普以國家利益為由，依據《格雷厄姆法案》豁免了對俄羅斯實施的一系列新的製裁和關稅。
items.summaryEn: Trump signed the Graham Bill, which targeted Russia over its invasion of Ukraine, into law in September.
items.summaryZh: 川普在9月簽署了針對俄羅斯入侵烏克蘭的格雷厄姆法案，使其成為法律。

items.title: 特斯拉發布了與SpaceX合作開發的、姍姍來遲的Roadster跑車，引發了合併猜測。
items.titleEn: Tesla unveils long-delayed Roadster developed with SpaceX, fueling merger speculation
items.titleZh: 特斯拉發布了與SpaceX合作開發的、姍姍來遲的Roadster跑車，引發了合併猜測。
items.summaryEn: Elon Musk first debuted the Roadster refresh concept in 2017 but Tesla has since missed every targeted delivery date.
items.summaryZh: 伊隆馬斯克於 2017 年首次發布了 Roadster 改款概念車，但特斯拉此後未能按時交貨。

items.title: 9月批發價格年增6.3%，創2022年以來最大漲幅。
items.titleEn: Wholesale prices jumped 6.3% annually in September, biggest gain since 2022
items.titleZh: 9月批發價格年增6.3%，創2022年以來最大漲幅。
items.summaryEn: September producer prices were expected to increase 0.6% month-over-month and 5.5% annually, according to the consensus estimate by Dow Jones.
items.summaryZh: 根據道瓊斯的普遍預期，9 月生產者物價預計將較上季上漲 0.6%，年減 5.5%。

items.title: 受汽油價格飆漲的影響，9月消費者價格年增3.7%。
items.titleEn: Consumer prices rose 3.7% annually in September as gas prices skyrocket
items.titleZh: 受汽油價格飆漲的影響，9月消費者價格年增3.7%。
items.summaryEn: The consumer price index was expected to increase 0.6% in September on a monthly basis and 3.6% from a year ago, according to the Dow Jones consensus forecast.
items.summaryZh: 根據道瓊共識預測，9月消費者物價指數預計將季增0.6%，年增3.6%。
